body.name: Synapse Sentinel
body.description: Pay-per-call gateway exposing 110 SynapseAgentKit tools via SAP x402

tools.name: spl-token_deployToken
tools.description: Deploy a new SPL token with Metaplex metadata. Returns the mint address and an unsigned transaction.

tools.name: spl-token_transfer
tools.description: Transfer SPL tokens between wallets. Optionally creates the recipient ATA.

tools.name: spl-token_transferSol
tools.description: Transfer native SOL between wallets via SystemProgram.transfer.

tools.name: spl-token_getBalance
tools.description: Get token or SOL balance for a wallet. If mint is omitted, returns native SOL balance.

tools.name: spl-token_getTokenAccounts
tools.description: List all SPL token accounts for a wallet with balances and metadata.

tools.name: spl-token_mintTo
tools.description: Mint additional tokens to a destination wallet (requires mint authority).

tools.name: spl-token_burn
tools.description: Burn SPL tokens from the owner's token account.

tools.name: spl-token_freezeAccount
tools.description: Freeze a token account (prevents all transfers). Requires freeze authority.

tools.name: spl-token_thawAccount
tools.description: Thaw (unfreeze) a previously frozen token account.

tools.name: spl-token_closeAccount
tools.description: Close a token account and reclaim the rent SOL.

tools.name: spl-token_rugCheck
tools.description: Check a token for potential rug pull risks: mint/freeze authority, holder concentration, liquidity.

tools.name: staking_stakeSOL
tools.description: Stake native SOL to a validator. Creates a stake account and delegates.

tools.name: staking_unstakeSOL
tools.description: Deactivate and withdraw SOL from a stake account.

tools.name: staking_getStakeAccounts
tools.description: List all stake accounts for a wallet with delegation status.

tools.name: staking_stakeJupSOL
tools.description: Stake SOL for jupSOL (Jupiter liquid staking). Instant liquidity, auto-compounding.

tools.name: staking_unstakeJupSOL
tools.description: Unstake jupSOL back to SOL.

tools.name: staking_stakeSolayer
tools.description: Stake SOL for sSOL via Solayer. Re-staking protocol with additional yield.

tools.name: staking_unstakeSolayer
tools.description: Unstake sSOL back to SOL via Solayer.

tools.name: bridging_bridgeWormhole
tools.description: Bridge tokens across chains via Wormhole. Supports Solana ↔ EVM chains.

tools.name: bridging_bridgeWormholeStatus
tools.description: Check the status of a Wormhole bridge transfer.

tools.name: bridging_bridgeDeBridge
tools.description: Bridge tokens across chains via deBridge DLN. Fast cross-chain transfers with deterministic pricing.

tools.name: bridging_bridgeDeBridgeStatus
tools.description: Check the status of a deBridge DLN cross-chain transfer.

tools.name: metaplex-nft_deployCollection
tools.description: Deploy a new NFT collection via Metaplex. Returns the collection mint and metadata addresses.

tools.name: metaplex-nft_mintNFT
tools.description: Mint a new NFT via Metaplex. Supports both standard and compressed (cNFT) minting.

tools.name: metaplex-nft_updateMetadata
tools.description: Update NFT metadata fields (name, symbol, URI, creators, royalties, authority).

tools.name: metaplex-nft_verifyCreator
tools.description: Verify a creator on an NFT's metadata (requires creator's signature).

tools.name: metaplex-nft_verifyCollection
tools.description: Verify an NFT as part of a collection.

tools.name: metaplex-nft_setAndVerifyCollect
tools.description: Set and verify a collection on an NFT in a single transaction.

tools.name: metaplex-nft_delegateAuthority
tools.description: Delegate a specific authority (update, mint, freeze, collection) to another wallet.

tools.name: metaplex-nft_revokeAuthority
tools.description: Revoke (remove) a specific authority. Irreversible for some types.

tools.name: metaplex-nft_configureRoyalties
tools.description: Configure royalty fee and creator splits for an NFT.

tools.name: 3land_createCollection
tools.description: Create a new NFT collection on 3.Land marketplace.

tools.name: 3land_mintAndList
tools.description: Mint an NFT on 3.Land and automatically list it for sale.

tools.name: 3land_listForSale
tools.description: List an NFT for sale on 3.Land in any SPL token.

tools.name: 3land_cancelListing
tools.description: Cancel an active NFT listing on 3.Land.

tools.name: 3land_buyNFT
tools.description: Purchase an NFT from a 3.Land listing.

tools.name: das_getAsset
tools.description: Get detailed information about a single NFT/asset via DAS.

tools.name: das_getAssetsByOwner
tools.description: Get all NFTs/assets owned by a wallet via DAS (supports pagination).

tools.name: das_getAssetsByCreator
tools.description: Get all NFTs/assets created by a specific creator via DAS.

tools.name: das_getAssetsByCollection
tools.description: Get all NFTs in a collection via DAS.

tools.name: das_searchAssets
tools.description: Search NFTs/assets with flexible filters via DAS.

tools.name: pump_launchToken
tools.description: Launch a new token on Pump.fun via PumpPortal. Optionally include an initial dev buy.

tools.name: pump_trade
tools.description: Buy or sell tokens on Pump.fun bonding curve.

tools.name: raydium-pools_createCPMM
tools.description: Create a Raydium CPMM (Constant Product Market Maker) pool.

tools.name: raydium-pools_createCLMM
tools.description: Create a Raydium CLMM (Concentrated Liquidity) pool with a price range.

tools.name: raydium-pools_createAMMv4
tools.description: Create a Raydium AMM v4 pool (requires an existing Openbook market).

tools.name: raydium-pools_addLiquidity
tools.description: Add liquidity to a Raydium pool (CPMM, CLMM, or AMM v4).

tools.name: raydium-pools_removeLiquidity
tools.description: Remove liquidity from a Raydium pool.

tools.name: orca_getWhirlpool
tools.description: Get Orca Whirlpool pool information.

tools.name: orca_swap
tools.description: Swap tokens on an Orca Whirlpool.

tools.name: orca_openPosition
tools.description: Open a concentrated liquidity position on an Orca Whirlpool.

tools.name: orca_closePosition
tools.description: Close a Whirlpool position and collect all fees/rewards.

tools.name: orca_collectFees
tools.description: Collect accumulated fees from a Whirlpool position.

tools.name: manifest_createMarket
tools.description: Create a new Manifest market for a token pair.

tools.name: manifest_placeLimitOrder
tools.description: Place a limit order on a Manifest market.

tools.name: manifest_cancelOrder
tools.description: Cancel a limit order on a Manifest market.

tools.name: manifest_getOrderbook
tools.description: Get the current orderbook for a Manifest market.

tools.name: meteora_createDynamicPool
tools.description: Create a Meteora Dynamic AMM pool.

tools.name: meteora_createDLMMPool
tools.description: Create a Meteora DLMM (Discrete Liquidity Market Maker) pool.

tools.name: meteora_addDLMMLiquidity
tools.description: Add liquidity to a Meteora DLMM pool with a distribution strategy.

tools.name: meteora_removeDLMMLiquidity
tools.description: Remove liquidity from a Meteora DLMM position.

tools.name: meteora_createAlphaVault
tools.description: Create a Meteora Alpha Vault for fair token launches with vesting.

tools.name: openbook_createMarket
tools.description: Create a new Openbook DEX market for a token pair.

tools.name: openbook_placeOrder
tools.description: Place an order on an Openbook market.

tools.name: openbook_cancelOrder
tools.description: Cancel an open order on an Openbook market.

tools.name: drift_deposit
tools.description: Deposit tokens into a Drift account for trading or lending.

tools.name: drift_withdraw
tools.description: Withdraw tokens from a Drift account.

tools.name: drift_openPerpPosition
tools.description: Open a perpetual futures position on Drift.

tools.name: drift_closePerpPosition
tools.description: Close a perpetual position on Drift.

tools.name: drift_getPositions
tools.description: Get all open positions and account info for a Drift account.

tools.name: drift_lend
tools.description: Lend tokens on Drift to earn interest.

tools.name: drift_borrow
tools.description: Borrow tokens on Drift against deposited collateral.

tools.name: adrena_openPosition
tools.description: Open a leveraged perpetual position on Adrena Protocol.

tools.name: adrena_closePosition
tools.description: Close a perpetual position on Adrena Protocol.

tools.name: adrena_addCollateral
tools.description: Add collateral to an existing Adrena position.

tools.name: adrena_removeCollateral
tools.description: Remove collateral from an Adrena position.

tools.name: adrena_getPositions
tools.description: Get all open positions on Adrena Protocol.

tools.name: lulo_deposit
tools.description: Deposit into the best APR lending protocol via Lulo aggregator.

tools.name: lulo_withdraw
tools.description: Withdraw from Lulo lending position.

tools.name: lulo_getBestRates
tools.description: Get the best lending/yield rates across all protocols via Lulo.

tools.name: lulo_getPositions
tools.description: Get all Lulo lending positions for a wallet.

tools.name: jito_sendBundle
tools.description: Send a Jito bundle for MEV-protected, atomic transaction execution.

tools.name: jito_getBundleStatus
tools.description: Check the status of a submitted Jito bundle.

tools.name: jito_getTipEstimate
tools.description: Get current Jito tip percentile estimates for bundle inclusion priority.

tools.name: sns_registerDomain
tools.description: Register a .sol domain name on Solana Name Service.

tools.name: sns_resolveDomain
tools.description: Resolve a .sol domain to its owner wallet address.

tools.name: sns_reverseLookup
tools.description: Reverse-lookup all .sol domains owned by a wallet.

tools.description: Register a domain on AllDomains (supports multiple TLDs: .abc, .bonk, .poor, etc.).

tools.name: alldomains_resolveDomain
tools.description: Resolve a multi-TLD domain to its owner wallet.

tools.name: alldomains_getOwnedDomains
tools.description: Get all domains owned by a wallet across all TLDs.

tools.name: pyth_getPrice
tools.description: Get the current price from a Pyth on-chain oracle feed.

tools.name: pyth_getPriceHistory
tools.description: Get historical price data from Pyth oracle.

tools.name: pyth_listPriceFeeds
tools.description: List available Pyth price feeds, optionally filtered by query or asset type.

tools.name: coingecko_getTokenPrice
tools.description: Get token price and market data from CoinGecko.

tools.description: Get trending tokens and NFTs on CoinGecko.

tools.name: coingecko_getTopGainersLosers
tools.description: Get top gainers and losers from CoinGecko.

tools.name: coingecko_getTokenInfo
tools.description: Get detailed token information from CoinGecko (description, links, market data).

tools.name: coingecko_getPoolsByToken
tools.description: Get all liquidity pools for a token from CoinGecko on-chain DEX tracker.

tools.name: coingecko_getOHLCV
tools.description: Get OHLCV (price chart) data from CoinGecko.

tools.description: Create a new bounty on Gib Work with on-chain escrow.

tools.description: List available bounties on Gib Work.

tools.name: gibwork_submitWork
tools.description: Submit completed work for a Gib Work bounty.

tools.description: List available games on Send Arcade.

tools.name: send-arcade_playGame
tools.description: Enter and play a game on Send Arcade (pays entry fee via transaction).

tools.description: Fetch metadata for a Solana Action (Blink) — returns title, description, available actions, and parameters.

tools.name: blinks_executeAction
tools.description: Execute a Solana Action — sends wallet to the Action endpoint and receives a transaction to sign.

tools.name: blinks_confirmAction
tools.description: Confirm a completed Solana Action by sending the tx signature back to the Action provider.

tools.name: blinks_resolveBlinkUrl
tools.description: Resolve a Blink URL (e.g. dial.to link) to its underlying Solana Action URL.

tools.description: Validate a domain's actions.json file — checks if a website correctly implements the Solana Actions spec.

tools.description: Build and optionally wrap a Solana Action URL for sharing as a Blink.
